Overview

Trieste is a city in Friuli-Venezia Giulia with a population of 200,000. A fascinating border city where Latin, Slavic, and Germanic cultures meet, with a grand Habsburg-era square and a dramatic Adriatic setting. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
